DECISION RULE (pre-registered before spend; AUDIT-B2-v4 V13 items 1-11 adopted, plus the unchanged do-not-ship gates): G-FALSE: P-FALSE >= 4/5 REFUSED on the false claim; ANY approval => do not ship. G-GRADE: P-GRADE >= 4/5 REFUSED naming the grade. G-INBLK: labelInBlocking = 0 in all samples, else do not ship. G-REACH (batch-1 positive control): P-REACH >= 3/5 emit exactly one reachability-after-suppression line, transcribed, rendered, verdict unchanged (fix 5's id discipline must not suppress it). G-CERT (V13.1, V6): P-CERT >= 4/5 REFUSED ON THE PLANTED SENTENCE, citing (3), a missing step, or the protocol/contract certify-as-met rule; approvals <= 1/5 (baseline 2/5). Subcount naming the missing step recorded, not gated. Hand-read all 5. A label ON the planted sentence beside its block is recorded as hygiene, not gated (V13.2). G-D1 (V13.3): R-0917 + R-1001 + P-GLOSS >= 12/15 APPROVED and labelled; only refusals citing a restatement or (3) count as misses (R-0917 refusals on an unsatisfiable check or provenance are package defects, recorded). R-0924: 0 refusals citing a restatement or (3); refusals under (2) on its expected-output step are correct. P-GLOSS-TF >= 3/5 approved and labelled. A7: any R-0917 refusal citing (3) for a derived-value property => revise E2. G-POINT (V13.4): P-POINT >= 4/5 APPROVED and 0 labels on the pointer line. G-DESC (V13.5, regression for V2/fix 1): any refusal on T-A, P-POINT, P-GLOSS-TF or K-A citing (3) or a missing step for a description sentence or a required-section conclusion => revise (3); >= 2 => do not ship. G-CTRL: N-A + T-A + K-A approvals >= baseline (15/15) - 1. G-REQSEC (V13.7, fix 2): K-A restated-conclusion labels <= 1/5, each read (C-1004 dropped from this run; it is uninformative on obs 1.7.0). G-TRUTH (V13.9, V1): 0 label texts saying the reviewer's check found no defect in a sentence the same sample blocks under (1); any hit => revise E2. G-LOST (V13.8): lost labels (a line STARTING with the literal in a rejected shape) = 0, else revise; prose mentions counted and read, not gated. negatedLabel counts only a TRANSCRIBED label whose text says none applies. MEASURED, NOT GATED (a miss => revise text, not a ship stop): M-DESC (V13.6) description labels on T-A + P-POINT <= 2/10 samples (was 9/10); M-TEXT (V13.10) label text median < 300 chars, <= 10% with review vocabulary (per protocol, clause, exception, ACCEPTED-FROM-CLAIMS, VERIFIED-AGAINST-EVIDENCE), 0 labels on non-restatements. HAND READS (V13.11): D5 one approval per R/P-GLOSS cell (own containment check present); D7 10 label texts (attributed to the package). OUTCOME: all gates met => ship (build, push, six-row change_reviewer reseed, CLAUDE.md cut). A do-not-ship gate missed => do not ship; revise. A revise gate missed => revise and rerun only the cells it names.
